sections.heading: Sharing model
sections.markdown:
- `shared` creates a stable, non-rebindable identity owned by the shared/system owner
- every cross-execution boundary consumes the same provenance-based capture plan
- inline values, published module-readonly values, and shared identities may cross directly
- execution-local graphs require explicit `copy(...)` or `move` from a rebindable local `var`; module-mutable state and short-lived views/pointers are rejected
- `go { ... }` is a zero-argument block form; pass owned local data with `go fn(x: T) -> R { ... }(copy(arg))`, `move arg`, or `go worker(arg)` as appropriate

sections.heading: await all
sections.markdown: `await all` requires a homogeneous collection of tasks: every element must have the same static `Task<T>` type, and the result is `Array<T>`. Await heterogeneous tasks individually, or convert each task to a shared enum / union / Json result type.

sections.heading: Atomic
sections.markdown: `Atomic<T>` wraps `int`/`float`/`bool` with lock-free atomic operations. Must be `shared`; `move` prohibited. Methods: `load`, `store`, `add`, `sub`, `fetchAdd`, `fetchSub`, `swap`, `compareExchange`, `toggle`. Optional `Ordering` enum parameter (default `SeqCst`).

sections.heading: Synchronization handles
sections.markdown: `Channel`, `Atomic`, coroutine-domain `sync.*` handles, and OS-thread-domain `sys.Os*` handles must be created with `shared` when named. Use `sync.*` inside coroutine code; use `sys.Os*` inside `sys.Thread` or other blocking OS-thread contexts.
